title: Machine-Assisted Discovery of Chondroitinase ABC Complexes toward Sustained Neural Regeneration.
summary: Iterative model-selected copolymers were synthesized and tested for retained enzyme activity, improving stabilization. Designed objects are polymers; neural regeneration itself was not demonstrated.
organization: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey; Princeton University
